title: Whiteboard Wednesdays deck spec (the object a deck-spec module returns)
description: A deck spec is a CommonJS module exporting ({fs, path, uri, dist, assets, arrow, source}) => spec. build-trial.cjs validates the rules below before writing anything.

id.description: Stable and unique within the deck; used in canonical links.

section.description: Small mono label above the title, e.g. '03 / The finished static'.

kind.description: A layout from references/layouts.md or a device from references/device-library.md.

parts.description: Trusted, authored HTML. Asset placeholders like {{AD}} are filled at runtime.

reveals.description: One reveal group per part, starting at 1 and contiguous.

source.description: The short line the audience sees under the slide.

register.description: One entry; see register-entry.schema.json. Its brand is replaced by the confirmed brand profile.

brandProfile.description: Path to the confirmed brand profile, relative to the spec. Overridden by --brand.

repeatAllowed.description: Slide IDs allowed to repeat the previous slide's kind, each with its reason in the slide map.

css.description: Deck-only layout CSS, scoped to the deck's own kinds.

file.description: Output HTML path, relative to the spec. Never inside the static build directory.
